B"H

# REMAINING WORK — Geelooy Futuristic Revelation

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos renews the instant; this ledger renews the work,
so no hidden brittle edge survives beneath a polished quirk.
Awtsmoos.com is the visible shore; the code beneath must be equally sure.

## Mission

Transform the public `geelooy/` surfaces into a coherent, fast, mobile-first, accessible, futuristic system while preserving real contracts and eliminating style leakage, overflow, accidental overlap, inconsistent interaction states, and tangled JavaScript/API boundaries.

## Open Work Graph

- [ ] Capture clean git baseline and preserve unrelated local changes.
- [ ] Discover nested `AGENTS.md` files and formatting/build contracts.
- [ ] Inventory public page families and their HTML/CSS/JS entry points.
- [ ] Map shared CSS, shared JavaScript, API clients, and runtime dependencies.
- [ ] Identify pages using inline/global styles or collision-prone selectors.
- [ ] Identify viewport overflow, fixed-position, z-index, and mobile hazards.
- [ ] Identify duplicated navigation, button, panel, form, card, and feedback patterns.
- [ ] Design a root-scoped, import-driven visual foundation with no global selectors.
- [ ] Add motion tokens and reduced-motion behavior.
- [ ] Add coherent hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, loading, and expanded states.
- [ ] Build retractable mobile-first navigation/panel primitives without accidental overlays.
- [ ] Build overflow-safe layout primitives with explicit z-index layers.
- [ ] Establish data-driven UI configuration and explicit JavaScript contracts.
- [ ] Refactor shared browser/API utilities into small documented modules.
- [ ] Preserve endpoint names, payloads, public exports, and existing navigation contracts.
- [ ] Improve static informational pages.
- [ ] Improve authentication/form pages.
- [ ] Improve catalog/navigation pages.
- [ ] Improve social/profile/heichel application surfaces.
- [ ] Improve editor/composer surfaces.
- [ ] Improve docs and API documentation surfaces.
- [ ] Improve utility/OS/tool surfaces where they share the same web foundation.
- [ ] Read back every touched file in full.
- [ ] Verify tab indentation in touched source files.
- [ ] Verify no compressed one-line logic in touched source files.
- [ ] Verify all new CSS selectors are localized beneath an explicit page/surface root.
- [ ] Verify every interactive primitive has relevant hover/active/focus-visible states.
- [ ] Verify reduced-motion behavior.
- [ ] Verify no accidental horizontal overflow at representative mobile widths.
- [ ] Verify z-index layers and overlay containment.
- [ ] Run syntax/import/build/tests available for touched modules.
- [ ] Browser-test representative page families on mobile and desktop.
- [ ] Inspect console/network errors for representative flows.
- [ ] Update durable documentation and migration guidance.
- [ ] Compare planned vs actual work and convert every delta into remaining work.
- [ ] Close only when no safe high-value discovered work remains within this migration pass.

## Completion Evidence

Completion requires file readback, syntax/build/test results, browser evidence on representative families, static style-scope checks, and an empty actionable remainder for the implemented migration layer.
